title: ClearPath Managed IT Services: Onboarding Kickoff, Go-Live and Pre-Onboarding Cancellation
content:
### Kickoff

Onboarding may be kicked off only after the onboarding fee invoice has been paid in full, or when no onboarding fee was posted because it was waived. Whether the fee is settled is read from the agreement's own billing ledger: the onboarding fee entry with its invoice number and amount, and the payments applied to that invoice.

| Onboarding fee on the agreement's ledger | Fee condition for kickoff met |
|---|---|
| Posted and paid in full | Yes |
| Posted, unpaid or partly paid | No |
| Never posted because the fee was waived | Yes |

The onboarding target in business days is a planning target, not a guarantee, and missing it earns no credit.

### Go-live and the initial term

Go-live is recorded when onboarding completes. The initial term starts on the go-live date, and the term end date is the day before the same day of the month the term's number of calendar months later. When that day does not exist in the target month, the last day of the target month is used as the anniversary and the term ends the day before it. Go-live posts the initial seat baseline equal to the contracted seats.

Hypothetical term dates:
- go-live 2025-03-15 on a 12-month term: anniversary 2026-03-15, term end 2026-03-14;
- go-live 2024-02-29 on a 12-month term: 2025-02-29 does not exist, so the anniversary is 2025-02-28 and the term ends 2025-02-27;
- go-live 2024-07-01 on a 36-month term: anniversary 2027-07-01, term end 2027-06-30.

### Cancellation before onboarding

A signed agreement may be cancelled by the client only before onboarding is kicked off; once onboarding has started the agreement can be ended only by notice after go-live. On a cancellation, an onboarding fee that was posted is reversed in full by a credit memo against that fee, and any amount already paid is refunded by the accounting team.

All of this applies to ClearPath Managed IT Services agreements.
